title: Country Climate and Development Report: Guinea
temporal_coverage: Climate projections through the 2060s and 2090s; macroeconomic modelling to 2050
methodology: CCDR combines climate-risk analysis with CC-MFMod macroeconomic and fiscal modelling.
limitations: Rainfall projections are uncertain; scenario results are model estimates, not observed impacts.

title: CDN 3.0 de la République de Guinée
organization: Government of the Republic of Guinea
geographic_coverage: Conakry, Forécariah, Boffa, and Kamsar coastal areas
temporal_coverage: Climate events reported for 2024–2025; proposed NDC implementation period 2026–2035
methodology: Government NDC 3.0 summarizes sectoral climate risks, vulnerabilities, and proposed adaptation actions.
limitations: Government-reported impacts and proposed actions; independent validation absent.
